1879060547.name: Battle Frenzy
1879060547.desc: Your Fervour is instantly increased as well as some additional fervour over time.

conditionalEffects.description: Battle Frenzy now restores 1 fervour every second over 10 seconds.

1879060803.name: Cracked Earth
1879060803.desc: Unstable earth deals Fire damage to several enemies.

conditionalEffects.description:
After using a Lightning Skill, your Frost Skills will slow enemies.

After using a Fire Skill, your Frost Skills will make enemies Brittle, increasing their incoming Critical Chance.

procEffects.description: DNT - Wild Sigils reduce the active cooldown of Sign of the Wild: Rage

1879064387.name: Guide to Esteldín
1879064387.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Esteldín.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879073219.name: Roaring Challenge
1879073219.desc: Your companion lets out a terrifying bellow and forces many enemies to target them.

1879089859.name: Guide to Michel Delving
1879089859.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Michel Delving in the Shire.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879093059.name: Seek The Worm
1879093059.desc: Nothing can escape your searching gaze. So long as it is a worm.

1879136963.name: Upper Hand
1879136963.desc: You quickly overwhelm your opponent, reducing their chance to parry or block your blows.\nWhile you have the upper hand, Blade Toss is more likely to knock down your opponents.

1879212099.name: D.R.A.G.O.N.
1879212099.desc: You don't know what D.R.A.G.O.N. stands for, so you best try this on someone else. Though there is some fine print: 'Made with 10% real dragons'.

1879213891.name: A Flesh Wound (Ranged)
1879213891.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front right leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879233859.name: War-steed: Heavy
1879233859.desc: The Destrier is a heavily armoured War-steed. Stalwart and imposing, The Destrier is bred for battle. The least agile and slowest of the war-steeds trades speed and maneuverability.

1879242307.name: Metal and Mettle
1879242307.desc: You use your sword and staff to deliver a powerful strike to the enemy before you.\n\nWhen your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will restore a small amount of power.

1879244867.name: Halt the Charge - Fire
1879244867.desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Riddermark Discipline your ranged damage is increased.

1879245635.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879245635.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline focuses on the chilling and enervating runes of storm. When carved and etched correctly you can manipulate the actions of your enemies.

1879267139.name: Upper-cut
1879267139.desc: You throw a punch at your enemy.

1879267651.name: Medium Fish-Net
1879267651.desc: Throw a medium net to catch fish.

1879302595.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Lossoth)
1879302595.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879316163.name: Copper-back Frog
1879316163.desc: Summons a copper-back frog to keep you company.

1879344579.name: Moth Kite
1879344579.desc: Brings out a moth kite for you to fly!

1879357635.name: Journey to the Hall of the King
1879357635.desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: Hall of the King

1879368643.name: Teacup Goat Kid
1879368643.desc: Brings out a teacup goat kid to keep you company.

1879374531.name: Return to Járnfast
1879374531.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Ironfold Dwarves, you're able to quickly return to Járnfast. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879385795.name: Corrupted Craban
1879385795.desc: Brings out a corrupted craban to keep you company.

1879410883.name: Steed of the Shimmering Breeze
1879410883.desc: A distinguished steed who has seen fit to carry you.

1879411779.name: Backhand Clout
1879411779.desc: A wide back-handed smash that may catch multiple enemies with its force.

procEffects.description: When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a modest Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Parry or Evade then deal damage to your attacker
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a significant Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
When you Evade an incoming attack, gain a powerful Critical Rating buff that scales with level.
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Parry and gain a Finesse Buff
DNT - Spenders have a chance to trigger a bonus light-type damage effect after a short delay.

1879414211.name: Yule Hobby-horse
1879414211.desc: A favourite Yule toy.\n\nYou may ride it in most towns and cities.

1879476163.name: Sail to Halrax
1879476163.desc: Navigate to Halrax in the Shield Isles with nearby fellows.

1879476803.name: Umbari Huorn
1879476803.desc: Summons an Umbari huorn to accompany you on your travels.

1879486019.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Belegaer Gull)
1879486019.desc: Summons an eagle-type companion.\n\nThis is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879491523.name: Return to Jirush
1879491523.desc: You're able to quickly return to Jirush in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879492163.name: Petty Criticism
1879492163.desc: Demoralize your foe with petty insults and criticisms.

conditionalEffects.description: Your shouts have a chance to apply Clinging Fear to your target. Your melee skills will capitalize on this fear, turning it into the Unrelenting Curses DoT effect.

1879506627.name: Sorcerous Study II
1879506627.desc: Your study of ancient malefic powers allows you to maintain a second malevolent spell until the final word is spoken.\n\n<rgb=#00ffff>Prepared spells deal less initial damage.</rgb>

1879516867.name: Vigilant Cobra
1879516867.desc: Summons a vigilant cobra to watch your back on your adventures.

1879522627.name: Major Ballad
1879522627.desc: Boosts healing capability and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.
